_comment: State for the /study-run time-boxed quest planner. Per-project. `calibration` is learned from plan-vs-actual over time: k_* are per-activity-class time-estimation factors (actual/estimated, EWMA with alpha), mode_multiplier is the ambition dial nudged by trailing completion rate. `active_run` holds the current quest board (null between sessions). `sessions` is the history that feeds calibration. Written by /study-run only — the tutor writes progress.json, not this file.

calibration.note: n_sessions < 3 => cold start: force Steady, label as calibration run, do not run the outer loop.
